captions.detailed: This object is a vintage screw-mount camera prime lens with a black-anodized and silver-metal finish. It features a threaded silver base mount, a wide, ribbed black focus ring in the middle, and a smooth black front barrel containing a light-blue glass lens element. When operated, the focus ring rotates continuously around the optical axis, while the front barrel extends forward linearly along the same axis via a simulated helicoid mechanism.
captions.instruction: Generate a vintage screw-mount prime lens in CadQuery. Ensure it has a silver threaded base, a ribbed black focus ring, and an extending front barrel with a glass lens element. Model the articulation with a revolute joint for the focus ring and a prismatic joint for the front barrel to simulate the helicoid mechanism.
captions.factory: The code constructs the lens assembly using several parts. The base mount is built from silver-colored cylinders with concentric cuts and a threaded profile. The focus ring is modeled as a cylinder with radial rectangular cuts to form the grip ribs, colored black. The front barrel is a smooth, hollowed cylinder containing a thin, light-blue cylinder representing the glass lens. The parts are connected via two joints: a continuous/revolute joint for the focus ring rotating about the Z-axis, and a prismatic joint along the Z-axis for the front barrel.
